scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @foliohub/contracts && npm run build --workspace @foliohub/api && npm run build --workspace @foliohub/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace @foliohub/api" "npm run dev --workspace @foliohub/web"
